Q1. What part of this repository should be changed?
Choices:
A. A workflow under `.github/workflows/` — reply with the workflow name or phase.
B. A helper script under `scripts/` — reply with the script path.
C. Documentation / prompts / config text — reply with the file path.
D. I’m not sure of the file yet, but I can describe the exact behavior to change. (RECOMMENDED)
Q2. What kind of improvement do you want?
Choices:
A. Fix a broken behavior — include the exact error, failing run, or reproduction steps. (RECOMMENDED)
B. Improve reliability / reduce noise / reduce flakiness — describe what is going wrong now.
C. Add or expand behavior — describe what should happen that does not happen today.
D. Docs/text-only improvement — describe the wording or section to update.
Q3. What should count as “done” for this issue?
Choices:
A. Provide 1-3 concrete acceptance criteria or a before/after example. (RECOMMENDED)
B. Point to an existing issue, PR, workflow run, or file that shows the desired result.
C. No strict acceptance criteria; use best judgment once I describe the target and problem.
